evals.prompt: Audit this Markdown directory for note health.
evals.expected: Requires an explicit root and performs a read-only audit by default.

evals.prompt: Fix trailing spaces in these notes.
evals.expected: Creates a plan with before and after hashes before apply, then snapshots and verifies preservation.
Produces a proposal with hashes and paths, and does not edit notes.

evals.prompt: Add missing last_verified and confidence to every note.
evals.expected: Reports missing metadata as proposal-only and does not choose confidence automatically.
Refuses permanent deletion and proposes recoverable archive for owner decision.

evals.prompt: Audit a folder of plain Markdown files.
evals.expected: Works without Obsidian conventions or a running app.
Uses root-relative paths and omits private absolute roots by default.
